# anthropic_vault_credentials (Data Source)

Lists the credentials stored in a vault. Secret values are never returned by the API and never appear here.

~> The Managed Agents API is in beta. This resource needs `api_key` (a regular workspace API key, not an Admin key) and `workspace_id` when the key can reach more than one workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Secret values are never returned; only metadata about each credential.
data "anthropic_vault_credentials" "ci" {
  vault_id = "vlt_01ExampleVaultId000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vault_id` (String) Vault id (`vlt_...`).

### Optional

- `include_archived` (Boolean) Include archived credentials. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `credentials` (Attributes List) Credentials. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))

<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Read-Only:

- `archived_at` (String) Archive timestamp.
- `auth_type` (String) `static_bearer`, `environment_variable` or `mcp_oauth`.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `id` (String) Credential id (`vcrd_...`).
- `mcp_server_url` (String) MCP server URL (bearer and OAuth credentials).
- `secret_name` (String) Environment variable name (environment_variable credentials).
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
